slug: 2025-03-31 Vodacom opens data center in Maputo, Mozambique

facts.fact: Data Center Dynamics reports that Vodacom's carrier-neutral Matola data centre, opened 2025-03-31, has direct access to the 2Africa subsea cable hosted in Vodacom Mozambique's equipment room in Matola.

note: Cable in service is implied by the data centre's access to it; document gives the opening date, no landing-station operator.
